title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1, and the orange-peel idea must be clear.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the live apps
body:
## Problem
The apps use red and blue discs and four curve colours; some colour-blind users cannot tell the projections apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
A palette and line styles (solid, dashed) that stay distinguishable for common colour-blindness types, in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`, `sessions/session-02/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All four curves distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a polar azimuthal map to Session 3
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's polar-map milestone does not exist yet; Mercator cannot draw the poles.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. Students ask which map to use for the Arctic.

## Expected outcome
A fifth projection function, an entry in `PROJECTIONS`, a Tissot picture and checkpoint lines.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Worst angle error at most 3 degrees and area spread at most 1.1 over lat 60 to 89
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a Lambert conformal conic projection
body:
## Problem
No shipped projection is both conformal and nearly equal-area for a mid-latitude country.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 3 and the mini-project: the example box lat 8 to 37, lon 68 to 97.

## Expected outcome
A conic projection with two standard parallels, validated with the finite-difference Jacobian.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Worst angle error at most 0.001 degrees and area spread at most 1.10 for the example box
- [ ] Short write-up of the standard parallels you chose

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a globe that unrolls into maps
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a globe unrolling into several maps with Tissot circles; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A GIF of at most 60 frames and 3 MB
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
